question: ‘Lent’ is a religious observance celebrated by the people who practice the ________ religion.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Christian**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• Lent is a period of 40 days, not counting Sundays, observed by Christians in preparation for Easter, commemorating the resurrection of Jesus Christ.

• It begins on Ash Wednesday and ends on Holy Saturday, the day before Easter Sunday.

• During Lent, Christians often practice fasting, repentance, and prayer to grow closer to God.

• The purpose of Lent is to replicate Jesus Christ's sacrifice and withdrawal into the desert for 40 days.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Ash Wednesday:**

• Ash Wednesday marks the beginning of Lent. It is a day of fasting and prayer.

• Many Christians attend a special service where ashes are placed on their foreheads in the shape of a cross.

• The ashes symbolize repentance and mortality.

• **Holy Week:**

• Holy Week is the final week of Lent, leading up to Easter Sunday.

• It includes important days such as Palm Sunday, Maundy Thursday, Good Friday, and Holy Saturday.

• Palm Sunday commemorates Jesus' triumphant entry into Jerusalem. Maundy Thursday remembers the Last Supper. Good Friday commemorates Jesus' crucifixion, and Holy Saturday marks the day Jesus' body lay in the tomb.

• **Fasting and Abstinence:**

• During Lent, many Christians give up certain luxuries or foods as a form of fasting and self-discipline.

• Some may also engage in acts of charity and increased prayer.

• The goal is to focus on spiritual growth and reflection.

• **Easter Sunday:**

• Easter Sunday is the culmination of Lent and Holy Week.

• It celebrates the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead, which is the cornerstone of Christian faith.

• It is a day of joy and celebration, often marked by special church services, feasts, and various cultural traditions.
